author: Rajesh Malhotra
title: Excellent location for transit and business meetings
comment: Stayed here for 2 nights during a conference at Aerocity. The airport shuttle was prompt, check-in was seamless, and the conference hall was well equipped with reliable high-speed Wi-Fi. The multi-cuisine restaurant serves authentic North Indian dishes.

author: Sarah Jenkins
title: Perfect layover hotel near Delhi Airport Terminal 3
comment: Had an 18-hour layover between flights. The hotel arranged an airport transfer without any hassle. Clean room, very quiet despite being near NH-8, and the bed was remarkably comfortable. Buffet breakfast had good continental and Indian varieties.

author: Vikram & Ananya Sen
title: Comfortable stay with warm staff hospitality
comment: The front desk staff were very polite and accommodating when our flight was delayed by 3 hours. Room was spacious and clean. Room service was fast and tasty. Great value for money in the Mahipalpur area.

author: Amitabh Sharma
title: Unbeatable value and strategic location near Aerocity Metro
comment: Hotel Kian is ideal for corporate travellers looking for cost efficiency without sacrificing essential comforts. Clean linen, hot water 24/7, and quick access to Aerocity corporate offices via metro.

author: David Miller
title: Good transit hotel with helpful front desk
comment: Good budget option very close to the international terminal. The staff assisted with early check-in and helped book a taxi at 4 AM for my departure flight. Safe and dependable.

author: Pooja Singhania
title: Modern boutique interiors and impeccable cleanliness
comment: We booked two rooms for our family vacation. The boutique aesthetics are chic, the bathrooms are ultra-clean with rain showers, and breakfast was delightful. Highly recommended!

author: Markus Weber
title: Top-notch soundproofing and comfortable workspace
comment: As a remote consultant, fast Wi-Fi and quiet rooms are non-negotiable. Urban Luxury exceeded expectations. The room work desk and ergonomic chair made remote working easy before my flight.

author: Kavita Rao
title: Warm hospitality and great dining options
comment: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Paradise International. Staff attended quickly to calls, room was neat, air conditioning was cold and quiet, and dining was flavorful.

author: Sanjay Verma
title: Cozy villa atmosphere right near the terminals
comment: Much quieter than typical highway properties. The garden courtyard is peaceful and the staff were very respectful and prompt.

author: Deepak & Sunita Aggarwal
title: Pleasant family stay with airy rooms
comment: Hotel Palm View provided very spacious rooms for our family. The kids loved the food and the staff made sure we had early breakfast before our flight.

author: Naveen Chhabra
title: Dependable budget transit option
comment: Clean room, hot water, speedy check-in and checkout. Highly convenient for early departures from T3.

author: Meera Nambiar
title: Grand lobby and spotless rooms
comment: Felt very safe as a solo woman traveler. The 24-hour reception and round-the-clock room service were prompt and polite.

author: Arun Patel
title: Boutique tranquility near Aerocity
comment: Opal Villa has charming decor, plush beds, and quick taxi connectivity. Great spot to recharge between hectic Delhi appointments.

author: Elena Rostova
title: Great value and helpful team
comment: Clean room, comfortable mattress, and the staff assisted us with currency exchange tips and taxi booking. Would book again for transit.
